title: The use of transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation to reduce opioid consumption in patients undergoing off-pump CABG: a randomized controlled trial.

title: Electroacupuncture and Growth Hormone for Quadriceps Atrophy Management Post-Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Prospective Study.

title: Transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation to prevent dizziness after microvascular decompression for hemifacial spasm: A randomized controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Adults undergoing microvascular decompression under total intravenous general anaesthesia were randomized to TEAS at GB20 and PC6 or sham immediately after extubation.
concise_private_rationale: All core criteria are explicit with eligible early postoperative timing and clinical outcomes.

title: [Effect of transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation on postoperative cough in lung cancer patients undergoing video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery].
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized VATS trial compares TEAS at named body acupoints with identical sham pads and reports cough and multiple clinical recovery outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible separable TEAS contrast with preoperative stimulation and highly evident general anaesthesia.

title: Intraoperative transcutaneous electroacupoint stimulation on early postoperative fatigue in patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized DBS-surgery trial compares intraoperative TEAS at ST36 and SP6 with inactive surface electrodes and reports fatigue and recovery outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible TEAS with separable sham control; BIS-guided propofol-remifentanil anaesthesia strongly supports general anaesthesia during the operative course.

title: [Clinical study of electroacupuncture therapy on postoperative rehabilitation of patients with knee fractures].
